actual_original_turns.route: Monodromy orbits, cyclic intermediate covers, and generator-count obstruction
actual_original_turns.result: Both targets hold for covers factoring through a nontrivial cyclic cover, including regular covers with nonperfect deck group. A regular deck group requiring more than three generators also suffices. The general transitive-action problem remains.

actual_original_turns.route: Elementary repeated-monodromy construction in disjoint handle blocks
actual_original_turns.result: Both targets hold when base genus is at least twice the order of the monodromy image. Two disjoint nonseparating curves with trivial monodromy produce a planar subsurface with trivial monodromy. No uniform argument covers the remaining low-genus, large-image cases.
